description: Change a target avatar's TSO permission level on the current lot. Covers two distinct UI flows: (1) the owner toggles a roommate's "builder bit" (Roommate ↔ BuildBuyRoommate) from the house-mode roommate list; (2) the owner promotes a donator to full Roommate, or demotes a donator back to Visitor, from the donator-management dialog on a community lot. Server-side `Verify` requires caller to be Owner (`Permissions >= Owner`) and rejects owner self-changes; on non-community lots the level is bounded to Roommate..BuildBuyRoommate. Distinct from `admit-ban-lot` (DataService admit/ban list) — this command mutates the in-VM roommate/builder sets.
call_signatures: cf $CF change-lot-permissions   # SCAFFOLD op — not yet implemented; handler may return ok:false or a stub. Prefer a concrete sibling op if your goal is actionable.
common_mistakes: This is a SCAFFOLD op — the convention is declared but the handler may be unimplemented or stubbed. Check the declaration's status field.
Relying on scaffold ops mid-run will either return a deferred marker or fail — prefer a concrete sibling op, and file an rd item if the missing behaviour blocks progress.
